page.overview:
What is Fraxure?

Fraxure is a bipedal reptilian Pokémon with dinosaur and draconian traits. Its sturdy, thickset body is composed of green and gray armor-like scales. It has long, sharp gray tusks with red tips protruding from either side of is mouth. Its mouth is beak-like, similar to that of a turtle. Its round eyes are scarlet red and the top of its head is green, tipped with a small spike. It has red claws on both its hands and feet, a long pointed tail with a red tip, and red specks on its gray belly.

Since Fraxure's tusks do not grow back when broken, this Pokémon diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after a fight. Fraxure are very territorial and can become particularly violent when protecting their territory from other Fraxure, a fight between two Fraxure over land can be very gruesome, as neither will back down until the other is either maimed or without a tusk.

These Pokémon will become anxious if they are not able to sharpen their tusks; they sometimes will even forgot searching for food in favor of looking for suitable stones to whet their tusks on. If one tusk breaks off in combat, the Fraxure will be rendered handicapped, not only in battle but in simple movement, as the tusks also provides these Pokèmon with balance.

Fraxure evolves from Axew starting at level 38 and evolves into Haxorus starting at level 48.
